presets.label: Success precision
presets.query: text = "succeed more or less" | ((text = "after revealing chaos tokens" | text = "would succeed at a skill test") & (text = "you get 1 skill value" | text = "you get 3 skill value"))

presets.label: Raise success
presets.query: (text = "after revealing chaos tokens" | text = "would succeed at a skill test") & text = "you get skill value"
